hooks.command: npx tsc --noEmit > /tmp/tsc-check.txt 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then tail -20 /tmp/tsc-check.txt; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"TypeScript errors found. Fix them before committing."}'; else echo '{"decision":"allow"}'; fi

npx vite build --mode production > /tmp/vite-build.txt 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then tail -30 /tmp/vite-build.txt; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Vite production build failed. Fix build errors before committing."}'; else echo '{"decision":"allow"}'; fi
